title: Profile, password, two-factor, sessions
caption: PF-04, PF-06, PF-07. Every signed-in account.

steps.title: Profile
steps.body: Change the full name, language (en, en-GB, en-US) and time zone, **Save changes**.
steps.expect: "Your profile is saved."; the shell shows the new name. A save from a stale second tab: PRECONDITION_FAILED with "Reload the page".

steps.title: Turn on two-factor
steps.body: **Set up two-factor authentication**, scan the QR code (or copy the key), type a code, **Turn on two-factor authentication**.
steps.expect: Ten recovery codes shown once ("Your recovery codes"); reload hides them; `accounts.mfa_enabled = true`, `mfa_enabled_at` set; ten rows in `account_recovery_codes`.

steps.title: Change password
steps.expect: "every other session was signed out"; the session list shrinks; OTA admin sessions end (`staffdeny:acct`); Mailpit: "Your Velexis password was changed".

steps.title: Sessions
steps.body: Sign in from a second browser; **Revoke session** on it; then **Sign out everywhere**.
steps.expect: "This browser" has no Revoke; the revoked row disappears; Sign out everywhere ends this browser too (`/sign-in?signedOut=1`).

steps.title: Turn off two-factor
steps.expect: Hidden for platform admins and for owners/admins of a live OTA (`mfa_mandatory`).
